lyric.txt: Today we're going to make cinnamon rolls
First, we mix the yeast with sugar and milk
Then, we mix the flour with sugar, butter, and eggs
After, the yeast 🦠 grows because they are living organisms
Next, we mix the yeast 🦠 with the flour 🌻 and let it rest 😴
After that, we flattened 👏 the dough 🍚, we add cinnamon 🪵, and we create the rolls 🥮
Finally, we heat 🔥 them in the oven 🎛️
